#
# An excerpt of the board trace of gl_test case 169 (dstex) through the
# NanoPC-T6's own Mesa, for the frame builder's depth-texture proof
# (src/mali/frame_tex_tests.rs): the two frames that sample a depth
# texture. For each: the command-stream words of its draw, the raw memory
# of the buffer that holds the draw's descriptors (resource tables, sampler,
# texture descriptor; 7ffffffd0000) and of the buffer that holds the shader
# program descriptors and the texture's plane (7fffffffd000); for the first
# frame also the ramp's texels (7ffffffea000).
#
# Board: NanoPC-T6 (RK3588, Mali-G610, GPU_ID 0xa8670005), Armbian,
# Linux 6.18.55-current-rockchip64, panthor 1.5.0, Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1
# (an OpenGL ES 3.1 context). The program, 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/
# 2026-10-20-mesa-refs/cases.c in its `dstex` mode (case 169's body), by
# the steps of tools/mali/mesa-board-ref.sh
# (PAN_MESA_DEBUG=linear,nocrc,dump,trace,sync), one dump file a frame,
# concatenated: 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-20-mesa-refs/mesa/
# mesa-dstex.pandecode, sha256
# 0ff39070be129ef46cd3e8302423bba74a03e9a2b7bef66f340b4d7b3c77c8ef
# (the run of 2026-10-23-tex-169/mesa gives the same stdout and pictures).
#
#   ramp:     frame 1, the 4x1 GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT / GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT ramp the
#             CPU uploaded (0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), sampled NEAREST, CLAMP_TO_EDGE
#             over the window: Mesa keeps it as Z16 UNORM (RAW16, row stride
#             64, swizzle RRR1); read back 0xff000000, 0xff555555,
#             0xffaaaaaa, 0xffffffff (luminance, Mesa's channels).
#   rendered: frame 3, the 64x64 GL_DEPTH_STENCIL texture frame 2 rendered
#             into as the depth and stencil attachment, sampled NEAREST,
#             REPEAT over the window: Mesa samples the attachment in place as
#             Z24X8 UNORM (RAW32, row stride 256, swizzle RRR1) at the
#             address of frame 2's ZS Writeback Base.
# Each block is headed by its source and its line range in the full file.
